lead.headline: McLaurin is expected to miss London; the flex now rests on Coker's quad
lead.deck: Doubtful and projected 0.0 by this afternoon. You already put Coker in the flex. Carolina called up a receiver today, so the one check left is their inactives at 16:50 on Sunday, with Kamara behind him.
lead.body: Terry McLaurin's hamstring got worse news, not better. Ben Standig reported this morning that despite early hope he would play through it, McLaurin is now likely to miss Sunday's game in London; ESPN lists him doubtful and has cut his projection from 13.1 to 0.0. You moved Jalen Coker into the flex at 09:30, which is the projection lineup. The trouble is that Coker is questionable too. He was limited on Thursday and Friday with a quad, Dave Canales wanted to keep evaluating him through the weekend, and this afternoon Carolina put Xavier Legette on injured reserve and elevated receiver Ja'seem Reed from the practice squad. One Panthers site reads the call-up as a bad sign for Coker; Legette's move explains it just as well. His 13.0 hasn't moved, so none of it is in the number. Justin Jefferson is out, which leaves no healthy receiver on your bench. The cover is Alvin Kamara, who plays Monday night and isn't on the Saints' Saturday report: if Coker is inactive at 16:50 on Sunday, Kamara takes the flex. Elsewhere nothing changed. Josh Allen has no designation, Isaiah Likely's Giants list nobody, Jordan Addison starts for Jefferson, and Chicago are still expected to start Tyson Bagent, which touches only the benched Kyle Monangai. On the wire, George Holani is the biggest riser and doesn't reach this lineup; DK Metcalf and Denzel Boston remain Tuesday's decision.
